item.title: 🟠 KnowledgeDeliver flaw exploited as a zero-day to install web shells
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Hackers exploited a critical zero-day vulnerability in a server running the KnowledgeDeliver learning management system (LMS) to deploy the Godzilla web shell. [...]

item.title: 🔴 Charter confirms data breach after ShinyHunters extortion threat
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — check monitoring and incident response readiness.
U.S. telecommunications giant Charter Communications has confirmed it suffered a data breach after the ShinyHunters extortion group threatened to leak stolen data unless a ransom is paid. [...]
